## Episode Thesis

Macro-focused episode with guest Johan Javeus on the ECB's 25bp rate hike, driven by energy-price inflation, and on high US long-term yields, which the guest attributes mainly to expectations that Fed short rates stay higher for longer. The guest warns that rising rates will sooner or later hurt equities, since 5% on US Treasuries is becoming an attractive alternative to stocks. He also calls AI a real, society-changing technology and notes the industry hype around it. No individual stocks were analysed.
